LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_NanoCosmeticReaction.label: nano-reshaping reaction
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_NanoCosmeticReaction.descript: A temporary tissue response to nano-reshaping. Greater severity causes more pain and slower work. Fades naturally by 0.10 per day; reshaping surgery and rituals are unavailable until it clears. Treatment and bed rest do not accelerate recovery.
